notes: Corrected the חֲצִי הַר הַגִּלְעָד chain: the accepted alignment gave the phrase's one written *the* to the construct הַר as a supplied determiner and left the article on הַגִּלְעָד unrepresented. Rule 29 governs the other way — the rectum is rendered anarthrously (*of Gilead*), so the present article takes the written *the* and the construct keeps only its own word, as `כּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל` → *the furnace of iron* does. A supplied *the* on a construct is licensed only where no article morpheme is present or for a second written *the* in a multi-level chain, and only one is written here.
This is the convention DEU.3.1 (*the way to Bashan*), DEU.3.3 (*the king of Bashan*) and DEU.3.5 (*the unwalled towns*) already follow in this chapter.
